rationale: The request explicitly selects Review mode for workflow-level obstruction caused by a required approval. The response performs only corroborated read inspection, distinguishes the requester-provided constraint from the observed blocked-state artifact and derived findings, ranks relevant friction, and preserves material unknowns as open decisions. Its recommendations remain tied to individual deficiencies—status, ownership, continuity, escalation, and recovery—without defining an end-to-end sequence or coherent replacement workflow. Execution events and identical before/after fixture hashes show no write attempt or modification. The visible “Review mode” label is required by the explicit mode phrase, and no unsupported real-world validation is claimed.
